record.paper_title: The puzzle of global Double Field Theory: open problems and the case for a Higher Kaluza-Klein perspective
record.original_question: Can the Higher Kaluza-Klein framework developed here for global Double Field Theory be extended to the Heterotic DFT case?

evidence.quote: The cases of Heterotic DFT and Exceptional Field Theory will be explored in papers to come.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Background. Double Field Theory (DFT) is a T-duality covariant reformulation of the supergravity limit of string theory in which the target space is locally doubled: each d-dimensional patch is replaced by a 2d-dimensional "doubled" patch with coordinates (x^i, \tilde x_i), equipped with an O(d,d) invariant pairing and subject to the strong constraint \eta^{MN}\partial_M\otimes\partial_N = 0. A higher Kaluza-Klein (HKK) global formulation of DFT realises the doubled space as the total space of a higher principal bundle for the abelian gerbe (2-group) associated to the Kalb–Ramond B-field: the doubled manifold is glued via a higher group of symmetries in an (∞,1)-category of smooth higher stacks, the strong constraint is recovered as invariance under the higher principal action, and the local 2d-dimensional model is patched coherently so as to encompass T-folds and non-geometric backgrounds.

Heterotic DFT is the extension of DFT appropriate to the heterotic string, in which the doubled tangent bundle is enlarged by a non-abelian gauge bundle with structure group G (typically E_8 × E_8 or Spin(32)/Z_2), so that the local model has signature O(d, d+\dim G) and the strong constraint and generalised Lie bracket are modified to incorporate the non-abelian gauge connection and its curvature.

Problem. Construct a global geometric formulation of Heterotic Double Field Theory within the higher Kaluza-Klein framework. Concretely:

(1) Identify the appropriate higher (smooth) group H — combining the abelian gerbe of the B-field with the non-abelian gauge group G — and the class of higher principal H-bundles whose total spaces realise the heterotic doubled space.

(2) Show that the heterotic strong constraint and the heterotic generalised Lie derivative arise globally as, respectively, invariance under the higher principal H-action and the bracket of H-invariant vector fields on the total space.

(3) Demonstrate that the resulting globally defined objects reproduce, in a local trivialisation, the standard local Heterotic DFT (with its O(d, d+\dim G) structure and Green–Schwarz-type modified Bianchi identity for the B-field), and that the patching data correctly encode heterotic T-duality, including non-geometric heterotic backgrounds (heterotic T-folds).
artifact.category_tag: Double Field Theory and higher geometry
artifact.status_search_result: A follow-up work by Alfonsi (arXiv:2108.10297, "Extended Field Theories as higher Kaluza-Klein theories") develops the higher Kaluza-Klein program further and addresses Exceptional Field Theory and related extended geometries, but a fully worked-out global higher-Kaluza-Klein formulation of Heterotic DFT specifically does not appear to have been completed in the literature found. The question therefore appears partially addressed but not fully resolved.

status_evidence.title: Extended Field Theories as higher Kaluza-Klein theories
status_evidence.snippet: Higher Kaluza-Klein framework extended to Extended Field Theories including DFT and Exceptional Field Theory.
status_evidence.claim: The higher Kaluza-Klein program has been extended beyond plain DFT, but heterotic DFT is not the focus.

status_evidence.title: Global Double Field Theory is Higher Kaluza-Klein Theory
status_evidence.snippet: Original higher Kaluza-Klein global formulation of DFT via abelian gerbe of the Kalb-Ramond field.
status_evidence.claim: Establishes the higher Kaluza-Klein global formulation for ordinary (non-heterotic) DFT.

status_evidence.title: From exceptional field theory to heterotic double field theory via K3
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses heterotic DFT obtained from exceptional field theory on K3.
status_evidence.claim: Heterotic DFT exists and is studied, but not via a global higher Kaluza-Klein construction.
